## Hi there! 👋

I'm **Ash** - a **Minecraft Bedrock Add-on Developer** and **Full Stack Engineer**, crafting custom game mechanics and high-performance web systems for global studios.

- 🎮 **Bedrock Dev & Marketplace Contents**: 5+ years of experience developing Gameplay loops, Scripting API systems, Entity Behavior, Vehicle & Weapon mechanics, JSON UI, Structures, Worldgen, Project packaging and QA - with multiple Minecraft Marketplace partner studios.

- 🌐 **Full Stack Web Development**: Leading and building internal web applications, database systems, and high-craft interfaces using SvelteKit, React, PostgreSQL, Supabase etc.

- 🧠 **AI Systems Integration**: Designing and integrating pipelines with **self-hosted/local LMs**, **ASR (speech recognition) models**, and **classifier LMs** (BS in Computer Science & Engineering, Major in Artificial Intelligence).

- 🤝 **Technical Leadership & Collaboration**: Experienced in leading development teams, coordinating with international stakeholders, and collaborating with multiple developers on large-scale marketplace projects.
